title: Migration Roundtrip
intent: Verify schema upgrades and downgrades preserve declared database invariants.
problem: Without ordered upgrade and downgrade scripts are executed against schema invariants, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the migration roundtrip contract.
context: This pattern addresses versioned relational schema changes ship; its concrete control is ordered upgrade and downgrade scripts are executed against schema invariants.
forces: Correctness requires that upgrade reaches the declared head once
Operational pressure can cause: duplicate columns break fresh installs
solution: Implement ordered upgrade and downgrade scripts are executed against schema invariants. Verify the anchored symbol `migration_versions` with `test_every_upgrade_has_a_downgrade` before reuse.
invariants: upgrade reaches the declared head once
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `duplicate columns break fresh installs` and fails closed if the migration roundtrip evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For migration roundtrip, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to ordered upgrade and downgrade scripts are executed against schema invariants.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: versioned relational schema changes ship
Do not apply when: storage is ephemeral and schemaless
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
